title: Salesforce (CRM) Lands VA Deal as Its Undervalued Narrative Gets Fresh Support
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 获得 VA 交易，其被低估的说法得到新的支持
summary: Salesforce (CRM) has secured a three year Agentic Enterprise License Agreement with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, a contract valued at up to US$1.6b that highlights growing demand for its AI driven government cloud services. See our latest analysis for Salesforce.
summary_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 已与美国退伍军人事务部签订了为期三年的代理企业许可协议，该合同价值高达 1.6 亿美元，凸显了对其人工智能驱动的政府云服务日益增长的需求。请参阅我们对 Salesforce 的最新分析。

title: Blackstone reportedly mulls second debt package for Anthropic chip deal
title_zh: 据报道 Blackstone 正在考虑 Anthropic 芯片交易的第二轮债务计划
summary: Investing.com -- Blackstone Inc. has begun early talks with investors about a second large debt package to finance Anthropic PBC's use of chips from Alphabet Inc.'s Google, Bloomberg reported Tuesday.
summary_zh: Investing.com——据彭博社周二报道，Blackstone Inc. 已开始与投资者就第二笔大型债务计划进行早期谈判，以资助 ​​Anthropic PBC 使用 Alphabet Inc. 旗下谷歌的芯片。
